purpose: Prepare deterministic IMPACT-01 merchant evaluation after a Brain-accepted real MCME-018 NETWORK_READY result and Owner-supplied real sanitized MCME-019 merchant evidence. This contract is not merchant evidence.

requirements.rule: MCME-018 must have actually executed on real MCME-017 evidence and Brain must have accepted its runtime result as NETWORK_READY. MCME-018 PREPARED_ONLY does not satisfy this prerequisite.
Owner must supply real sanitized IMPACT-01 merchant identity and merchant/downstream evidence.

impact_candidate_1_mapping_contract.assembly: Start from the Brain-accepted REAL MCME-018 runtime Gate A record/result. Preserve its accepted property/network facts unchanged, bind candidate_slot=IMPACT-01 and network.name=impact.com, then map only real sanitized MCME-019 merchant/downstream evidence.
impact_candidate_1_mapping_contract.unknown_rule: Any merchant/downstream field not proven by real sanitized MCME-019 evidence remains UNKNOWN/null.
impact_candidate_1_mapping_contract.verified_rule: VERIFIED/FAIL evidence items must carry real sanitized source_reference_sanitized and observed_at values satisfying the Gate A schema.
impact_candidate_1_mapping_contract.no_prefill_rule: PREP must not contain a real or fictional merchant/program identity as runtime truth.
impact_candidate_1_mapping_contract.recorded_at_rule: Set at runtime from the sanitized evidence assembly event; PREP does not invent it.

deterministic_evaluation_path.evidence_digest: Use canonical evaluator evaluation_id = SHA-256 canonical digest of the complete sanitized Gate A record.
deterministic_evaluation_path.deterministic_requirement: Identical IMPACT-01 runtime input must produce identical canonical output and evaluation_id.

reconciliation.exact_duplicate: Same IMPACT-01 reconciliation key + same evaluation_id => reconcile/reuse the existing result; do not duplicate the merchant path.
reconciliation.superseding_evidence: Same IMPACT-01 key + changed real evidence/evaluation_id => append/supersede the IMPACT-01 evidence revision and re-evaluate.
reconciliation.merchant_identity_binding: The first real Owner-confirmed MCME-019 merchant public name + program public identifier binds IMPACT-01.
reconciliation.merchant_identity_conflict: A different merchant/program identity later presented on IMPACT-01 is a fail-closed reconciliation conflict requiring Brain review; it must not silently replace the binding.
reconciliation.cross_network_rule: IMPACT-01 must use network.name=impact.com. Awin evidence must never be relabeled as IMPACT evidence.
reconciliation.slot_rule: MCME-020 runtime accepts IMPACT-01 only. IMPACT-02 remains blocked until a Brain-accepted real MCME-020 runtime terminal MERCHANT_FAIL. IMPACT-03 is forbidden.

outcome_contract.note: Intermediate canonical stages remain non-terminal and must not open MCME-021.
